about: Walks a person through a page one step at a time. A step is a card: centred over a dimmed page when it points at nothing, beside a ringed element when it points at one, or fixed to a corner of the window. Back, Next, the arrow keys, Escape and the close button move through the tour or end it, and focus returns to the button that started it.

announcement.about: One step without a backdrop that points at a new control. Got it ends the tour.
announcement.description: Download any report as a CSV file, filtered the way you see it.
announcement.heading: New: export to CSV
announcement.title: Announcement

checklist.about: Floating steps with no target, fixed to the bottom corner of the window. A press outside the card leaves the tour open, because the tour sets `closeOnInteractOutside` to false.
